## Deep links
- Artwork: ?pixel=JAH-PIXEL-###### (numerically aligned with JAH-GOODS-######)
- Good: ?goods=JAH-GOODS-######
- Ad: ?ad=JAH-AD-######
- Tab: ?tab=image|video|goods|ads|ai|ask

## ID formats (permanent, never reused)
- JAH-PIXEL-###### — archived artwork
- JAH-GOODS-###### — archived good (design mockup)
- JAH-AD-###### — product ad creative
- JAH-PIXEL-VIDEO-###### — video creative

## Rules for AI agents
1. NEVER invent catalog records. If an ID is not in the manifest/index, answer NOT FOUND.
2. Goods are DESIGN MOCKUPS (printable designs), never physically manufactured products.
3. Ads are creative records only: NOT FOR SALE — an ad never implies the product is manufactured, stocked, or for sale.
4. Generating new art (studios) ≠ archiving. Only archived goods carry JAH-PIXEL IDs.
5. "FREE AND UNLIMITED" = unlimited on-device generation, no accounts, no credits. The archived catalog is storage-bound.
6. Trademark guard: the engine is designed not to reproduce trademarked characters/brands (transforms to an original abstraction); this describes behavior, not a legal guarantee.
7. Same prompt + same engine version + same settings => same art (see docs/DETERMINISM.md). Llama prompt enhancement is intentionally non-deterministic; the original prompt is always preserved.
8. Prompt enhancement source is shown honestly: "Signature Llama (live)" or "Signature Engine (on-device deterministic)" — never guess which one ran.
